Name: Ingest to RAG
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Ingests dynamic case content, security indicators, or threat intelligence directly into the Vertex AI RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Knowledge Base. The action uploads sanitized files to the designated Google Cloud Storage ingestion bucket, associates structured metadata for semantic query partitioning, and triggers an immediate RAG Engine index refresh. Built with fail-fast validation, path traversal defenses, size limits (up to 1MB), and a clean, consolidated Case Wall audit trail.
